newsitem.title: USA: GA Financial to buy back up to 5 pct of shrs.
newsitem.headline: GA Financial to buy back up to 5 pct of shrs.

text.p: GA Financial Inc said Tuesay it has received regulatory approval from the Office of Thrift Supervision to repurchase up to 5 percent, or 422,750 shares, of its outstanding common stock.
It said it will make the repurchases in open-market transactions, subject to the availability of stock and that the repurchase plan must be completed by March 26, 1998.
GA Financial is the holding company of Great American Federal Savings and Loan Association, headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
